WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sold.*, COALESCE(ret.ret_units,0) AS ret_units FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sku) ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.category, p.sku
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT 'lines' k, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(SUM(quantity) AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) d,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date) AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(MIN(sale_date) AS VARCHAR) f, CAST(MAX(sale_date) AS VARCHAR) g, CAST(MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS VARCHAR) h FROM l
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(SUM(receipts) AS VARCHAR), CAST(SUM(units_sold) AS VARCHAR), '', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(MIN(business_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(MAX(business_date) AS VARCHAR), ''
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'qtyneg', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), '', CAST(SUM(quantity) AS VARCHAR), '', '', '', '', '' FROM l WHERE quantity<=0

SELECT 102 AS store_id, 'Helsinki Pitäjänmäki' AS store_name, cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku
LIMIT 3
